title: Sunset Monuments and Memorials National Mall Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Washington, DC’s most iconic monuments at sunset. Join an expert guide along the National Mall to see these historic landmarks come to life as evening lights illuminate the nation's capital.

Start at the whimsical Albert Einstein Memorial before pausing for reflection at the moving Vietnam Veterans Memorial. Stand on the historic steps of the Lincoln Memorial, site of Dr. King’s "I Have a Dream" speech, and take in views across the Reflecting Pool.

Walk past the striking statues of the Korean War Veterans Memorial and visit the powerful Martin Luther King, Jr. Memorial along the Tidal Basin. Stroll through the grand arches of the World War II Memorial, catch a breathtaking view of the White House from the South Lawn, and conclude beneath the soaring Washington Monument glowing against the night sky.

Packed with rich history and stunning views, this guided tour offers an unforgettable evening experience!
